plan.purpose: Exploratory four-arm physical matrix for immutable method storage without duplicate names or spare capacity
plan.safety: Guarded private mount/PID/net namespace, before/after stock health and owned-directory cleanup per run
plan.memory: End-of-window proc counts are diagnostic, not precise memory acceptance. Independently measure retained and construction-peak requested Rust heap with actual ADD_OBJECT dispatch on both versions.
plan.failure_rule: Stop on collection, correctness, identity, health or cleanup failure; retain raw failed window
plan.analysis: All per-block values and paired medians. New high-resolution own-process CPU fields are separate from old tick+reaped-child fields. Four blocks are exploratory, no formal superiority/equivalence verdict. Do not pool pre-power-loss samples.
plan.hypothesis: One canonical method blob supplies the ACL name. Boxed immutable blobs and method lists remove duplicate names and unused capacity. Check all latency, own-process CPU and full-daemon memory diagnostics; do not infer speed from allocations.
plan.retention_rule: Reject correctness failures. Do not claim full superiority or promote this runtime change on pilot point estimates alone. Report all latency/CPU signs, memory diagnostics, and allocation-only evidence separately. Investigate apparent new regressions before retaining.
plan.build_control: Same actual /tmp/owrt-core-release/ubusd source root, SDK, toolchain, cwd and release flags as before; previous exact-root reconstruction reproduced before bytes.
plan.client_control: Frozen ca1a912 client and dependencies plus only process CPU clocks; same binary on all four arms. Do not pool R95/R96 measurements.

method: Paired exploratory blocks; full per-run values; no confidence or equivalence claim
scope: ubusd only, private router namespace, 10 lanes; object counts (64, 128)
memory_note: End-of-matrix proc counters; not PSS, precise RSS, per-lane peak or whole-system memory
